response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js expertise, direct AI-agent infrastructure experience, and a broad multi-language background (Java, C#, DLang, Swift) that aligns well with the role's secondary stack needs. He lacks explicit React/Nest.js/Vitest mentions and no cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) is directly listed despite AWS CDK experience noted at Optilyz, but his depth, testing tool authorship, and current work on MCP/agentic frameworks make him a strong candidate worth interviewing.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (15+ years) spanning frontend, backend, and infrastructure
Current hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, directly matching a required skill
Strong testing culture — author of testing frameworks/libraries (Fluent-Asserts, Trial) and TDD practitioner
concerns: No explicit mention of React, Nest.js, or Vitest — core primary stack tools
Limited explicit cloud/containerization detail beyond Docker and AWS CDK; no Kubernetes/GCP/Azure specifics
Resume shows heavy use of DLang/Ember historically, which may indicate less recent depth in the exact required primary stack

key_factors.factor: Deep, broad full-stack seniority and multi-language proficiency
